blurb: Guests take a guided tour of the vineyard and winery followed by a tasting of Schramsberg sparkling wines. Public tours and tastings last one hour and fifteen minutes. Private tours are available for groups of 8-12 guests by appointment in the morning hours.
extraNote: 48 hour cancellation policy for tour events · Tour and tasting fee is applicable regardless of wine purchase · No tasting-only experience; tastings must be with a tour by appointment · Refunds for damaged or flawed wine purchased directly · Visitor Center at 1210 Grayson Avenue, St. Helena, CA
